tweets.text:
Not all heroes wear capes. The quick thinking of four CBP officers at Baltimore Washington Intl Airport saved a toddler's life. As the family waited for inspection, officers noticed the child was choking and turning blue. Without hesitation, officers initiated the Heimlich maneuver and cleared the child's airway.  Our officers are always ready to respond, not just to protect our borders, but to protect our children and save lives.

Read more:  https://t.co/fFylYbLFHg
